objective: Finish the notebook compute lane with dedicated Kaggle, Colab, and Lightning MCP diagnostics plus provider-specific live verification and CI coverage.

rulesConsidered: Notebook runtimes are an execution and experimentation substrate, not implicit F06 worker authority.
MCPs are bounded integration surfaces and do not replace Overseer, Guardian, CAS, F07, or ReleaseAuthorization.
Provider completion is not physical artifact truth; F07 and CAS remain authoritative.
No self-hosted PandaStack sandbox is part of the hosted sandbox plane.
Secrets must remain environment-bound and must never be exposed as MCP arguments.

forensicFindings: The existing notebook live workflow referenced a missing factoryos:verify:notebooks package script.
Colab long-running-operation polling used the beta URL prefix rather than the documented operations path.
Colab runtime creation did not always send an explicit NONE accelerator for CPU runtimes and runtime IDs were not normalized to the provider naming constraints.
Kaggle execute-to-provision did not pass the caller credential bundle.
Dedicated provider-specific notebook MCP servers were not present.
changes: Added provider-specific live verification for Kaggle, Colab, and Lightning.
Added physical MP4 plus SHA-256 and byte-length proof for the Kaggle smoke.
Added optional Colab runtime create/delete control-plane smoke without inventing generic code execution.
Added CPU-first Lightning Studio live smoke with explicit run exit-code verification.
Added dedicated Kaggle, Colab, and Lightning MCP servers with connection-check and capability tools only.
Added a direct MCP JSON-RPC protocol verifier that discovers tools and executes each provider connection check.
Added notebook MCP package typecheck jobs to notebook-fabric CI.
Fixed provider adapter defects identified by CI and live-path inspection.
research: Current provider adapter contracts and notebook-fabric .okf documentation.
Current official Kaggle, Colab, and Lightning provider API/SDK documentation used to align live lifecycle semantics.

security.notes: No provider secret values are committed. MCP tools read credentials from environment only and do not expose arbitrary command execution or worker authority.

trainingReadiness.authority: F06 worker admission and F07 artifact truth unchanged

verificationPlan: Run repository CI and notebook-fabric contract checks.
Run the dedicated MCP package typechecks.
Execute the provider and MCP live smoke with repository secrets for each provider.
Merge only after required blocking CI lanes are green.
notes: The PASS disposition means the change is internally complete and governed; external provider live evidence is deliberately recorded as pending until a credentialed workflow run is executed.
No notebook MCP is promoted to F06 worker authority by this change.
